what: A note on the API surface
title: ESPN basketball endpoints -- NBA & MBB
text: ESPN exposes basketball data three public, unauthenticated API hosts, hoopR reaches : site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/basketball/{league} stable. serves scoreboards, teams, rosters, schedules, news, injuries, standings, player team season stats. sports.core.api.espn.com/v2/sports/basketball/{league} carries deeper resources: athlete indexes, per-event detail (odds, win probabilities, officials, broadcasts), seasons, venues, coaches, NBA draft, transactions. Big collections paginate via $ref links. site.web.api.espn.com/apis/common/v3/sports/basketball/{league} carries per-athlete deep detail – season overview, stats category, game--game logs, situational splits. ’s least stable three; older seasons sometimes return 404, every athlete represented. ’s fourth host (cdn.espn.com/core) surfaces information site-v2 /summary endpoint already parse, don’t wrap . league slugs URL paths mens-college-basketball nba. matter ’re building requests hand. Rate limits. ESPN doesn’t publish . practice, requests arriving faster one per second occasionally come back HTTP 429 silently empty payloads. ’re looping many games athletes, drop Sys.sleep(1) calls. Proxies. ESPN wrappers don’t accept per-call proxy = argument; call package’s HTTP layer directly. Set proxy top session options(hoopR.proxy = "http://host:port") (list, authenticated proxies) every ESPN call pick automatically.

what: Working with the NBA draft and transactions
title: ESPN basketball endpoints -- NBA & MBB
text: draft, free agency, transaction logs exist NBA side – NCAA doesn’t pro-style draft ESPN, transfer portal isn’t part ESPN’s basketball API. ’re stitching together roster history, natural sequence draft -> free agents -> transactions, joined athlete_id.

title: ESPN basketball endpoints -- NBA & MBB
text: endpoints exist ESPN deliberately wrapped: handful endpoints wrap known data quirks: espn_mbb_injuries() espn_mbb_team_injuries() – ESPN rarely populates injury data college basketball. espn_mbb_game_odds() – always empty; ESPN doesn’t carry NCAA lines. espn_nba_freeagents() – empty outside FA window. espn_*_athlete_awards() – sparse athletes. espn_*_athlete_eventlog() – returns $ref URLs, parsed stats. Use _athlete_gamelog() instead. espn_*_season_info() – mostly $ref URLs. web-common-v3 endpoints – legacy seasons return HTTP 404. something looks , empty tibble far often correct, expected return bug. ESPN’s basketball coverage uneven across leagues, seasons, franchise tenures, hoopR mirrors unevenness honestly rather papering .

what: Recipe 8: A whole season at once, the fast way
title: NBA Cookbook
text: story. don’t want one game. want every game – full season play--play model . Calling espn_nba_pbp() loop thousand game_ids work, also slow rude ESPN’s servers. load_ prefix exists precisely : pre-built, pre-cleaned season files. grammar lesson: load_ prefix changes performance contract, subject. load_nba_pbp() espn_nba_pbp() hand play--play; first hands whole season fast, second hands one game live. Reach load_ ’re research across many games, espn_ want one specific, fresh game.

code: library(DBI) con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "nba.sqlite")  # `dbConnection` + `tablename` -> write straight to disk while loading. load_nba_pbp(   seasons      = 2020:2024,   dbConnection = con,   tablename    = "nba_pbp" )  dbDisconnect(con)

title: NBA Cookbook
text: ’re corporate campus network, traffic may need go proxy. hoopR understands proxies three layers, reach least invasive one works. Layer 1 – set whole session. want 99% time. covers every function package – ESPN, NBA Stats, KenPom, loaders, . Layer 2 – one call, one proxy. Every NBA Stats API function (nba_*) threads ... HTTP layer, can override proxy single call: grammar-flavored caveat: per-call proxy = works nba_* Stats API functions pass ... . espn_*, kp_*, load_* functions don’t take per-call proxy – , use session option Layer 1. prefix tells capability: nba_ functions ones wired per-call overrides. Layer 3 – let environment decide. ’d rather put proxy R code , hoopR honor standard environment variables: read libcurl automatically whenever haven’t set explicit proxy. ’s right layer shared scripts CI, proxy property machine, analysis.
code: # Plain proxy. options(hoopR.proxy = "http://proxy.company.com:8080")  # Authenticated proxy -- pass a list and it's spread into the request. options(hoopR.proxy = list(   url      = "http://proxy.company.com",   port     = 8080,   username = "saiem",   password = Sys.getenv("PROXY_PASS") ))  # From here on, nothing changes -- just call functions normally. espn_nba_team_roster(team_id = 13, season = most_recent_nba_season()) nba_leagueleaders(season = "2024-25") nba_leaguestandings(   season = "2024-25",   proxy  = "http://other-proxy.company.com:3128" ) #> list() Sys.setenv(   http_proxy  = "http://proxy.company.com:8080",   https_proxy = "http://proxy.company.com:8080",   no_proxy    = "localhost,127.0.0.1" )

title: Get CEBL Games — cebl_games
text: CEBL API, owner-approved gray area: wrappers read league's FastAPI service (api.data.cebl.ca, backend CEBL Stats Hub) X-Api-Key hub's page bundle ships every browser. key issued third parties developer terms found; cebl.ca's terms use reviewed. runtime reads key bundle run time, falls back documented constant, never prints , raises hoopR_asset_fetch 'key rotated?' hint persistent 401. www.cebl.ca/robots.txt disallows nothing. Payloads redistributed release assets; requests spaced least 1 s apart. Season calendar year (May August) = sdv END year: mapping. first season 2019. unknown season, team player answers empty list, runtime raises hoopR_no_data. Ids CEBL's ; relocated franchise two team ids (cebl_teams lists 15). API box-score, play--play shot route. live Genius LiveStats (organisation CEBL, see genius family): cebl_games cebl_player_gamelog carry Genius match id genius_match_id, parsed stats URLs (derived, fetched; match cancelled game may data). home_team_id Genius team 1 away_team_id team 2 (checked match 2600563). completed schedule rows null scores (2026), cancelled game status CANELLED (API's spelling) null zero scores. schedule lists unplayed games , wrapper refuses unfinished game. Aggregates decimal strings upstream double . Players' names, nationality birth date public bio; contact data served. Errors classed conditions: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, empty list, -null profile: unknown season, team player), hoopR_bad_request (bad argument, HTTP 400 / 422) hoopR_asset_fetch (key API still refuses one re-read, non-200, non-JSON body, error envelope, body another season, team player), inheriting hoopR_error. HTTP 500 API's answer bad id retried. Wrappers raise; never return empty frame. Deliberate divergence: string column API sends object, list objects, carries compact JSON ({"name":"TSN"}), sdv-py's String cast writes Python's str(dict) repr ({'name': 'TSN'}). string column committed fixtures carries object.

title: Get ESPN Women's College Basketball Team Detail — espn_mbb_team
text: Era-correct team identity men's college basketball program specific season, plus available $ref URLs deeper resources (record, statistics, leaders, athletes/roster, coaches, college, etc.). Backed core-v2 endpoint sports.core.api.espn.com/v2/sports/basketball/leagues/mens-college-basketball/seasons/{season}/teams/{team_id}. Historical depth goes back 1939 ESPN. Older seasons return fewer $ref keys; missing refs become NA. Era-correct team identity NBA franchise specific season, plus available $ref URLs deeper resources (record, statistics, leaders, coaches, etc.). Backed core-v2 endpoint sports.core.api.espn.com/v2/sports/basketball/leagues/nba/seasons/{season}/teams/{team_id}. Historical depth goes back 1947 (NBA founding). Older seasons return fewer $ref keys; missing refs become NA.

title: EuroLeague Game Points (shot chart) — euroleague_game_points
text: Unofficial, keyless API, supported Euroleague Basketball; hoopR wraps (wrap-: payloads redistributed release assets). function mirrors sdv-py's euroleague_game_points(): arguments, defaults snake_case columns, one row per sdv-py row. Coordinate frame, measured reference capture (E2025 game 1, 158 rows; U2025 game 1, 176 rows): Units: integer centimeters. Origin: hoop. 2FG radii run 8-512 cm, 3FG radii 722-925 cm (FIBA arc 675 cm), zone (rim) sits radius 8-33 cm. teams mapped onto one basket; coord_y grows away baseline toward court (-6 865 cm every team E game, -69 1028 U game; 3FG rows sit y 414-865). Negative y behind hoop (U game rows 69 cm behind , .e. behind backboard). coord_x signed left / right hoop (-683 696 cm); 3-point zone H x < 0 x > 0. sideline positive (shooter's view scorer's table) UNVERIFIED data alone. Free throws located: FTM rows carry coord_x = coord_y = -1 zone = "" (sentinel, spot 1 cm hoop). Filter plotting. zone letters -: rim, B / C close left / right, D / E mid, F / G long two, H / three. live API's codes space-padded fixed-width strings (TEAM = "IST       "); every string cell stripped. GENIUS_PROXY environment variable http(s) proxy URL (never printed logged). Unofficial use public source: payloads redistributed release assets. Org season. Every competition ORG code plus competition id (comp_id): genius_competitions() lists org's competitions sdv END-year season (START-year org lists 2025-26 season 2026), genius_match_competition() maps game competition, data.json names date, competition season. hosted ORG can differ LiveStats ORG /u/ (NZNBL vs NZN). Match ids one global sequence across every Genius customer. data.json carries global team player id: tno (1 2) pno -game numbers; finished games read. Errors (classed conditions, inheriting hoopR_error): hoopR_no_data Genius nothing request (HTTP 404, S3 AccessDenied 403, empty 200 hosted host, empty recent-games window, schedule widget matches); hoopR_bad_request HTTP 400 / 422 URL Genius route (e.g. non-numeric id); hoopR_asset_fetch answer unknown: CloudFront "Request blocked" 403, rate limit 5xx, intermittent HTTP 500 "website error occurred" page (transient = TRUE: retry later), dead connection, error envelope, cut-page, unfinished game, body another match, competition ORG.

text: Loads season-level NBA coaching staff data scraped NBA Stats API. One row per coach-team-season triple. Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline reads raw JSONs hoopR-nba-stats-raw publishes csv/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_coaches release tag. Loads season-level NBA draft picks scraped NBA Stats API (drafthistory-style outputs). One row per pick. Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline reads raw JSONs hoopR-nba-stats-raw publishes csv/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_draft release tag. Loads per-event 10-man -court lineup (5 home + 5 away) scraped alongside NBA Stats API play--play feed. One row per play--play action, player slot's NBA Stats person id. Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline publishes csv.gz/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_game_lineups release tag. Loads per-game inactive player list scraped NBA Stats API – InactivePlayers result set boxscoresummaryv2. One row per inactive athlete-game pair, full per-game roster: use load_nba_stats_player_game_logs() athletes play. Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline publishes csv/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_game_rosters release tag. Loads season-level 5-man -court lineup statistics (leaguedashlineups-style outputs, Base measure). Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline publishes csv/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_lineups release tag. Advanced/Misc/Scoring/ Opponent/Four Factors measures 2/3/4-man groupings, use load_nba_stats_leaguedash() table = "lineups_*". Loads game-level officials data scraped NBA Stats API (boxscoresummaryv2-style outputs). One row per official-game pair. Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline publishes csv/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_officials release tag. Loads season-level NBA play--play scraped NBA Stats API modern game-feed. One row per play--play action, shot location, /-court lineup joins available via load_nba_stats_game_lineups(). Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline publishes csv.gz/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_pbp release tag. Loads per-player per-game box scores scraped NBA Stats API boxscoretraditionalv3-style output. One row per athlete-game pair. Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline publishes csv/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_player_boxscores release tag. Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline publishes csv/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_player_game_logs release tag. Loads season-level NBA player statistics (leaguedashplayerstats-style outputs, Base measure). Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline publishes csv.gz/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_possessions release tag. Loads season-level NBA team rosters scraped NBA Stats API. One row per athlete-team-season triple. Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline publishes csv/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_rosters release tag. Loads season-level NBA schedules scraped stats.nba.com/leaguegamefinder (regular season + playoffs combined, pre-rejoined home/away). Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline publishes csv/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_schedules release tag. Loads shot events scraped NBA Stats API. Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline publishes csv/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_standings release tag. Loads per-team per-game box scores scraped NBA Stats API boxscoretraditionalv3-style output. One row per team-game pair. Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline publishes csv/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_team_boxscores release tag. Loads season-level team statistics (leaguedashteamstats-style outputs, Base measure). Backed hoopR-nba-stats-data pipeline publishes csv/parquet/rds artifacts nba_stats_team_season_stats release tag. title: Load hoopR NBA Stats League Dashboard cube — load_nba_stats_leaguedash
text: Loads one asset nba_stats_leaguedash release tag – parameter cube supersedes narrower Base-measure tags (load_nba_stats_player_season_stats(), load_nba_stats_team_season_stats(), load_nba_stats_lineups(), load_nba_stats_standings()). cube publishes 36 tables per season route Advanced/Misc/Scoring/Usage/Defense/Opponent/Four Factors measures, 2/3/4-man lineup groupings, *_bio/*_master wide joins, player tracking (drives, passing, touches, catch--shoot, pull-shooting, rebounding, speed/distance). Coverage floors differ table individually enforced (global 1996 floor ): lineups_* tables start 2007-08 season player_tracking_* tables (catchshoot/pullupshot, go back 1996) start 2013-14 season. Requesting --range season tables 404s gracefully warning contributes rows, nba_stats_* loader.

title: Load cleaned NCAA men's college basketball play-by-play from the data repo — load_ncaa_mbb_pbp
text: Loads season-level NCAA men's college basketball play--play. One row per event, reconstructed 5-man lineups, possession numbering, shot context (transition/paint/second-chance), ESPN game-id crosswalk. Produced sdv-py ncaa_mbb engine (stats.ncaa.org play--play parsed, cleaned, enriched); backed ncaa-mbb-hoops-data pipeline, published ncaa_mbb_pbp release tag csv.gz/parquet/rds. Loads shot-chart events NCAA men's college basketball – one row per field goal attempt, court coordinates, distance, shot zone, made/missed result. Coordinates available 2019 season onward (stats.ncaa.org publish shot-location data ), seasons 2019 floor even though sibling NCAA MBB datasets start 2010. Produced sdv-py ncaa_mbb engine; backed ncaa-mbb-hoops-data pipeline, published ncaa_mbb_shots release tag csv.gz/parquet/rds. Loads reconstructed 5-man lineup stints NCAA men's college basketball – one row per contiguous stretch specific 5-player lineup court team, /scoring, shooting, rebounding splits plus matching opponent (opp_*) splits. Produced sdv-py ncaa_mbb engine's lineup reconstructor; backed ncaa-mbb-hoops-data pipeline, published ncaa_mbb_lineups release tag csv.gz/parquet/rds. Loads reconstructed 10-man matchup stints (home 5-man lineup crossed away 5-man lineup) NCAA men's college basketball – one row per contiguous stretch lineups court together, score stint start/end team's lineup rosters. Produced sdv-py ncaa_mbb engine's lineup reconstructor; backed ncaa-mbb-hoops-data pipeline, published ncaa_mbb_matchup_stints release tag csv.gz/parquet/rds. Loads possession-level data NCAA men's college basketball – one row per offensive possession, -court 5-man lineups teams, points scored, assist/transition/garbage-time flags, possession's first last event types. Produced sdv-py ncaa_mbb engine's possession detector; backed ncaa-mbb-hoops-data pipeline, published ncaa_mbb_possessions release tag csv.gz/parquet/rds. Loads within-team regularized adjusted plus-minus (RAPM) ratings NCAA men's college basketball – one row per player-team-season, fit teammate lineup variation within team's possessions (cross-team national RAPM). Produced sdv-py ncaa_mbb engine's RAPM model top reconstructed lineup/possession data; backed ncaa-mbb-hoops-data pipeline, published ncaa_mbb_rapm_within_team release tag csv.gz/parquet/rds. Loads league-wide regularized adjusted plus-minus (RAPM) ratings NCAA men's college basketball – one row per player-season, fit lineup variation across Division stints season (within-team RAPM). Produced sdv-py ncaa_mbb engine's league-wide stint-ridge RAPM solver (Torvik-gated Division teams) top reconstructed lineup/possession data; backed ncaa-mbb-hoops-data pipeline, published ncaa_mbb_rapm release tag csv.gz/parquet/rds. Loads advanced per-player, per-game box scores NCAA men's college basketball – one row per player-game, shooting splits zone (rim/mid/3), transition half-court splits, assisted-vs-unassisted splits, shot-zone efficiency rates. superset traditional box score (points/rebounds/assists/steals/blocks/turnovers/fouls included alongside advanced splits). Produced sdv-py ncaa_mbb engine; backed ncaa-mbb-hoops-data pipeline, published ncaa_mbb_player_box release tag csv.gz/parquet/rds. Loads advanced per-team, per-game box scores NCAA men's college basketball – one row per team-game, offensive/defensive ratings, shot-zone rates efficiency (rim/mid/3), rebounding/assist/turnover rates, matching opponent (d_*) splits. Produced sdv-py ncaa_mbb engine; backed ncaa-mbb-hoops-data pipeline, published ncaa_mbb_team_box release tag csv.gz/parquet/rds. Loads lightweight season roster NCAA men's college basketball – one row per player-team-season games-played count. fuller roster (jersey, class, position, height, hometown, high school), use load_ncaa_mbb_team_rosters(). Produced sdv-py ncaa_mbb engine; backed ncaa-mbb-hoops-data pipeline, published ncaa_mbb_rosters release tag csv.gz/parquet/rds. Loads full season roster NCAA men's college basketball – one row per player-team-season jersey number, class year, position, height, hometown, high school, games played/started. Produced sdv-py ncaa_mbb engine; backed ncaa-mbb-hoops-data pipeline, published ncaa_mbb_team_rosters release tag csv.gz/parquet/rds. Loads season schedules/results NCAA men's college basketball – one row per game home/away teams final scores. Produced sdv-py ncaa_mbb engine; backed ncaa-mbb-hoops-data pipeline, published ncaa_mbb_schedule release tag csv.gz/parquet/rds. Loads season-level stats.ncaa.org team-id / conference crosswalk NCAA men's college basketball – one row per team-season. Useful joining ncaa_team_id columns ncaa_mbb_* datasets back team name conference. Produced sdv-py ncaa_mbb engine; backed ncaa-mbb-hoops-data pipeline, published ncaa_mbb_team_ids release tag csv.gz/parquet/rds.

title: Reduce NBA Stats API result sets — nba_bind_sets
text: nba_bind_sets() row-binds sets one long tibble, tagging row origin (tactic B). Use sets share schema, simply want stacked origin column (e.g. draft rounds, per-mode stat blocks). Columns absent given set fill NA. nba_join_sets() successively left-joins sets one wide tibble shared key (tactic C). Use sets different facets entity (e.g. player stats + team stats keyed game player id). nba_nest_sets() keeps keep_cols (plus set name) wide nests every column list-column, preserving data single flat schema can hold (tactic D). Use incompatible sets (e.g. player profile's season totals + career totals + awards). Recover set tidyr::unnest(). three accept named list tibbles – nba_*() return, output nba_stats_map_result_sets() – return single tibble.

title: Aggregate NBA Player-Tracking Stats Across Multiple Seasons — nba_tracking_aggregate
text: Fetches leaguedashptstats dashboards combination seasons season_types, aggregates results entity (PLAYER_ID Player, TEAM_ID Team) following contract ported sportsdataverse-py's aggregate_tracking_frames: Identity columns (*_ID, *_NAME, *_ABBREVIATION, non-numeric string column TEAM_CITY) carried via first() — never summed. *_FG_PCT / *_FT_PCT recomputed summed FGM/FGA FTM/FTA denominators (denom 0 -> NA); *_FG_PCT / *_FT_PCT column whose makes/attempts pair absent dropped rather recomputed. *_PCT columns (e.g., DRIVE_PTS_PCT — "% total" rates) dropped output additive. remaining numeric columns summed (numeric-content gate, mirroring sportsdataverse-py dtype.is_numeric() rule).

Use "Totals" aggregation; per-game averages meaningfully additive. pt_measure_type Tracking measure type string, e.g. "Drives", "SpeedDistance", "Passing". Passed directly nba_leaguedashptstats. Default "Drives". player_or_team "Player" (default) "Team". Determines entity key used group aggregation (PLAYER_ID TEAM_ID). league_id League identifier string. Default "00" (NBA). ... title: NBL Rosetta Match — nbl_rosetta_match
text: Unofficial: JSON proxy behind nbl.com.au (API NBL documents supports). terms use reviewed; payloads redistributed release assets. Gated referer, key: every request carries Origin / Referer set nbl.com.au (runtime sends ); without host answers 403 MISSING_API_KEY, raised hoopR_asset_fetch. Fills hole ESPN: ESPN's nbl feed box scores plays 2025-26 NBL season (stats provider changed Genius Sports Sportradar DataCore year). nbl_rosetta_match_pbp full event log shot x/y 2025-26 , shape, back 2011-12 (WNBL 2014-15). Matches 1979 box scores . One host serves three organisations; pass org='nbl' (default), 'wnbl' 'nbl1'. NBL1 second tier (men's women's conferences, calendar-year seasons). Season = END year (2026 = 2025-26) everywhere. Rosetta's year START year NBL WNBL 1998-99 calendar year NBL1 1979-1997 winter seasons; runtime maps . Year 1998 holds two seasons (calendar 1998 1998-99). Ids: <entity>id columns DataCore ids (UUID v1; join ), rosetta<entity>_id Rosetta's . match_id DataCore fixture id every match route keyed . Unknown ids, orgs types answer 200 rows (hoopR_no_data). Rosetta caches body per path serves whatever query string, page cut someone else's limit refused (hoopR_asset_fetch); retry cache entry expires. Errors: hoopR_no_data Rosetta answers 404 rows (unknown match, team, player season id, org season type nothing, season progress); hoopR_asset_fetch 403 gate body, stub error envelope, page cut Rosetta's path cache, body another org, season entity one asked , failed fetch; hoopR_bad_request unknown org / season_type, malformed id, HTTP 400 / 422.

what: RealGM (realgm_*) — Cloudflare-challenge bypass via headless Chrome
title: hoopR 3.1.0
text: RealGM sits behind Cloudflare JavaScript challenge (cf-mitigated: challenge) returns HTTP 403 every libcurl-based client (httr2, httr, rvest) regardless headers — Cloudflare fingerprints TLS handshake (JA3) demands JavaScript proof--work mint cf_clearance cookie. earlier source audit recorded RealGM dead basis. dead — reachable real browser engine, 17 realgm_*() wrappers now cover NBA endpoint surface: Players & personnel realgm_players() — active NBA player index (position, ht/wt, age, current team, years service, pre-draft team / international club, nationality). realgm_players_abroad() — NBA-affiliated players international rosters, NBA-rights status (view first-party feed provides). realgm_future_free_agents() — projected free-agent classes Bird / veteran status, production, player’s listed agent. realgm_coaches() / realgm_gms() — current head coaches / general managers tenure nationality. Standings, teams & stats realgm_standings() — conferences record, streak, splits. realgm_teams() — team index division conference. realgm_player_stats(season, stat_type, season_type) — qualified-player leaderboards (Averages / Totals / Per-X / Advanced / Misc, across Regular Season / Playoffs / Preseason / Summer League). realgm_team_stats(season, stat_type, season_type) — team statistics. realgm_individual_seasons() / realgm_individual_games() — -time best individual season / single-game leaderboards. Draft & salary realgm_draft(year) — past-draft results (rounds 1–2 + undrafted), pre-draft team nationality. realgm_draft_prospects() — current draft-prospect statistics. realgm_early_entry() — early-entrant / withdrawal list. realgm_salary_cap() — salary-cap history & projections (cap, tax, aprons, exceptions). realgm_rookie_scale() — rookie-scale contract amounts pick. Transactions realgm_transactions() — league transactions log (RealGM publishes dated narrative, table, parses page DOM one row per transaction real Date). Self-describing returns carry query parameters back columns (realgm_player_stats()/realgm_team_stats() echo season/stat_type/ season_type; realgm_draft() echoes draft_year round label). Every wrapper drives headless Chrome optional chromote package (Chrome solves challenge natively ~2 seconds). chromote + Google Chrome therefore Suggests-level requirement realgm_* family ; every hoopR source still works standard HTTP stack.
